description: A PHP script that creates and updates a fixture for testing the package_manager component in Drupal, involving copying JSON data, removing files, and running Composer commands.

classes.name: PackageManagerFixtureCreator
classes.description: Final class responsible for creating and updating a test fixture for Drupal's package manager.

methods.name: createFixture
methods.description: Creates or updates the fixture by copying JSON data, removing files, and running Composer commands.

methods.name: runComposerCommand
methods.description: Executes a Composer command in the fixture directory and returns its output.

methods.name: removeAllExcept
methods.description: Removes all files in a directory except those specified in the whitelist.
